content:
Overview

Verviers is a city in Liège with a population of 55,000. A historic wool-processing center in the Vesdre valley, with beautiful 18th-century architecture and easy access to the High Fens nature reserve. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
